description: Guided setup of a linked VV/VH global time-resolved anisotropy fit: load polarised decays, background-correct the IRFs, set instrument corrections and define lifetime/rotation spectra.

accepts.name: decays
accepts.summary: The polarized IRF and decay curves: named IRF/prompt for the response and VH/perp for the perpendicular channel, else in the order IRF VV, IRF VH, data VV, data VH (IRF then data for stacked VV/VH files).
